title: Vitis vinifera essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Vitis vinifera essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the leaves and berries of the grapevine plant. It is commonly used in herbalism for its purported benefits in supporting respiratory health and reducing inflammation. This preparation is often applied topically or inhaled to alleviate symptoms of bronchitis and asthma. It may also be used to promote relaxation and ease stress-related conditions. However, its use should be approached with caution due to potential toxicity if not properly diluted.
